items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: my brothers would get King Watsky and Buzz Harvey and the guys to come over and they'd play

ctx.x: Where would you think Larry got his inspiration, his idea of style? You got any idea? I really... Who would have been before him to... You know how everybody has somebody that they like very much in a jazz musical way.

Yeah, I think everybody is inspired, John, but I really don't know who inspired Larry. Maybe it could have been Freddie Burns. Because he was always at the house with my older brothers playing, you know. And I had three sisters and them, the girls in the neighborhood, you know, and the boys in the neighborhood. They'd give a little party in the house and of course my brothers would get King Watsky and Buzz Harvey and the guys to come over and they'd play, you know, and have a lot of fun.

Oh, by the way, while I think of it, what about the piano? Before the Dixieland, I understand they didn't usually use a piano. Some of the old bands used just bass and guitar or something. You know, is that true in the bands that Larry played with too at first? Did they have a piano or wait until late years or what?
